protectiveFactors.rule: Activity ≥3 days/week AND usual duration ≥30 minutes
protectiveFactors.notes: Use option IDs D3_4/D5_7 and M30_59/M60_PLUS
16-17 uses 18-30 band if participation is enabled

protectiveFactors.rule: None=100; one category=75; two=50; three or more=25
protectiveFactors.notes: PREFER_NOT/NA treated as unavailable and sets Recovery Potential limitation flag

protectiveFactors.rule: None=100; one category=75; two or more=50
protectiveFactors.notes: UNSURE/PREFER_NOT/NA sets limitation flag; no medication advice

driverRules.subject: Ranking
driverRules.rule: Sort eligible domains by score descending; exact ties use fixed order MR,HS,SR,CH,SL,IB,BS
driverRules.tieOrFallback: No LLM selection; null/<25 domains excluded

driverRules.subject: Co-primary
driverRules.rule: If top two eligible scores differ by ≤3, report them once as one co-primary pair
driverRules.output: Co-primary pair, then next highest-ranked distinct eligible domain if one exists
driverRules.tieOrFallback: No duplication; no ineligible fallback; preserve canonical tie order
